content:
[V|low] top-right | Test-domain emails (.test) and "local mirror" debug strings visible in production UI.
[L|med] top-right | Search button overlaps the search input row, floating unanchored on the far right with no shared container.
[S|med] top-right | Search button sits in a separate row from the "Sync now" button, breaking the right-edge alignment rhythm.
[S|low] toolbar | The header row "Customers" and "Sync now" sit on a different vertical center than the search row, creating uneven top spacing.
[H|med] footer line | "4 customers in the local mirror" duplicates the header count "4 customers (of 4)" with equal visual weight.
[H|low] footer | Debug/internal wording ("local mirror") exposed as user-facing text.
[C|high] bottom two-thirds | Entire lower half of the screen is an unmanaged dead zone below the customer list.
[C|med] right of search input | Large horizontal gap between search field and Search button leaves an unstructured empty band across the top.
[S|low] table | "Open" buttons are detached from the table edge, floating with inconsistent right margin inside the row.
[H|low] last-contact column | "Never" in gray competes weakly with "264d ago" style, ambiguous hierarchy for empty states.
[V|low] conversations column | Conversation counts (3/2/1/0) look like raw backend values with no unit or label formatting.
[C|low] table bottom | Table card ends abruptly at row 4 with no pagination or visual affordance for list continuation.

TOTAL 12
